t: Robust DEWALT Tough 10m tape measure designed for use on demanding jobsites and in various trades. A durable 32mm wide, Mylar-coated, carbon steel ToughBlade offers resistance to abrasion and corrosion, and the rubber-reinforced ABS plastic ToughCase offers protection against drops. An oversized metal impact plate safeguards the 3-rivet true zero end hook. Featuring double-sided print for vertical and overhead measuring, metric and imperial scales for versatile use, and a 4m standout reach for efficient single-person use. Ideal, highly accurate measure for professionals in construction and general building work. Includes removable magnet for added convenience.
b: Mylar-Coated Steel Blade with 3-Rivet True Zero End Hook
